title: qa(checklist): two more package-authored QA recipes (qa-media-constraints, qa-feeds-disabled) answer 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX at their first object save, and neither may declare the namespace qa
body:
Filing gate ①: a finding with a named location, measured through a public door. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023, session `session_01JQwxbaFpnMwgpCgneKe2qS`) from the #26791 card thread (PR #26875, os-dev report 6451454918, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Finding (measured on a fresh stock showcase boot at main `8eef9a8d`; re-read before acting)

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json`, recipe `qa-media-constraints`, step 2: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_media?package=com.objectstack.qa.media` answers 422 `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` ("Rename it to media_qa_media").
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, recipe `qa-feeds-disabled`, step 2: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_nofeeds?package=com.objectstack.qa.feeds` answers 422 `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` ("Rename it to feeds_qa_nofeeds").
- Cause, as in #26791: each step-1 manifest declares no `namespace`, so the install derives one from the id's last segment (`media`, `feeds`), and the `qa_`-named objects do not carry it. A runner replaying either recipe literally provisions nothing and scores the opting-in items `blocked(fixture)`.

## Constraint

PR #26875 fixes `qa-scratch-authz` by declaring `namespace: "qa"` on `com.objectstack.qa.attachments`. A namespace has one owner, so if either recipe here also declares `qa`, installing two of them on one boot answers `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (registry.ts `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT_CODE`). These two need another namespace their names already carry, or a rename.

## Wanted

- Each recipe replayed once on a stock showcase boot (REST only) after the fix, recorded in its `provenance`; every later step and opting-in item names the objects consistently, each with revision +1 and a history row citing this card.
- If co-installing two QA recipes on one boot is a supported run shape, say so in the recipe that might collide.

**Size:** S. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none. Lands after PR #26875 (`attachments-storage.json` is shared).
